description: Exact residual-height and p-adic-depth accounting for weighted products of primitive growing beta Casoratians

exact_class.exclusions: sums with cancellation, arbitrary block/Hankel determinants, and coefficients not generated by primitive transfer minors
exact_class.portfolio: A=product_i P_(h_i)(n)^(w_i), D=product_i C_(h_i)(n)^(w_i), h_i>=2, w_i>=1

open: a uniform short-return lower bound or construction for the actual high levels
growing sums with cancellation or arbitrary growing block/Hankel determinants
unbounded portfolio multiplicity with genuinely independent arithmetic input
the uniform v_p(q_n) log p=O(n) theorem or a sufficient little-oh aggregate
the actual clearing-divisor and transverse matching correlation
Route 1 and every conclusion about e+pi

theorem.bounded_K_consequence: if K is fixed and the portfolio reaches depth s with H=O(n), then some h_i=O(n/log n) satisfies p^ceil(s/K)|q_(n+h_i)
theorem.canonical_antiperiod_optimum: for K slots and s=Kq+r, the minimum guaranteed gap cost is (K-r)(p^q-1)+r(p^(q+1)-1)
theorem.canonical_fixed_K_barrier: O(n) residual height in the canonical anti-period class forces s log p=O_K(log n)
theorem.deoverlap: all formulas hold with s=(v_p(q_n)-v_p(D_m))_+, the surviving Item265 exponent
theorem.height_gap_tradeoff: L log(4n+6)<=H<=L log(4(n+L+1)); therefore H=O(n) iff L=O(n/log n)
theorem.scope_limit: a new uniform short-return theorem could beat the canonical anti-period portfolio and is not excluded
